name: L3 QA 签字流程
description: L3 测试员 QA 签字流程，对照 TaskPack 验收清单逐项检查
author: Pipeline-Sys

nodes.name: 参数接收
nodes.expression: ({ signoff_id: 'QA-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,'') + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase(), task_id: inputs.task_id, signer: inputs.signer, started_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: 解析验收清单
nodes.description: 从 TaskPack 提取 Acceptance Checklist
nodes.expression: (function() { const content = nodes.load_taskpack.output.content || ''; const checklistMatch = content.match(/Acceptance Checklist[\s\S]*?(?=##|$)/i); const items = []; if (checklistMatch) { const lines = checklistMatch[0].split('\n'); lines.forEach(line => { const match = line.match(/^\s*-\s*\[([x\s])\]\s*(.+)/i); if (match) { items.push({ checked: match[1].toLowerCase() === 'x', text: match[2].trim(), auto: false, status: 'PENDING' }); } }); } return { checklist_items: items, total_items: items.length }; })()

nodes.name: 创建默认验收清单
nodes.expression: ({ checklist_items: [{ text: '交付物已落盘', auto: true, status: 'PENDING' }, { text: '代码通过 lint 检查', auto: true, status: 'PENDING' }, { text: '代码通过类型检查', auto: true, status: 'PENDING' }, { text: '测试通过', auto: true, status: 'PENDING' }, { text: '无冻结目录修改', auto: true, status: 'PENDING' }], total_items: 5 })

nodes.name: 运行 Lint 检查
nodes.command: if echo "${inputs.auto_checks}" | tr -d ' ' | grep -qi 'lint'; then cd game && npm run lint --if-present 2>&1 | tail -20 || echo 'LINT_SKIPPED'; else echo 'LINT_SKIPPED'; fi

nodes.name: 运行类型检查
nodes.command: if echo "${inputs.auto_checks}" | tr -d ' ' | grep -qi 'typecheck'; then cd game && npm run typecheck --if-present 2>&1 | tail -20 || npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20 || echo 'TYPECHECK_SKIPPED'; else echo 'TYPECHECK_SKIPPED'; fi

nodes.name: 运行测试
nodes.command: if echo "${inputs.auto_checks}" | tr -d ' ' | grep -qi 'test'; then cd game && npm run test --if-present 2>&1 | tail -30 || echo 'TEST_SKIPPED'; else echo 'TEST_SKIPPED'; fi

nodes.name: 运行构建检查
nodes.command: if echo "${inputs.auto_checks}" | tr -d ' ' | grep -qi 'build'; then cd game && npm run build --if-present 2>&1 | tail -20 || echo 'BUILD_SKIPPED'; else echo 'BUILD_SKIPPED'; fi

nodes.name: 检查冻结目录
nodes.description: 确保没有修改冻结目录
nodes.command: git diff --name-only HEAD~1..HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^design/ai-native/0[01]_' && echo 'FROZEN_MODIFIED' || echo 'FROZEN_OK'

nodes.name: 汇总检查结果
nodes.expression: (function() { const results = { lint: nodes.run_auto_lint.status === 'SUCCESS' && !nodes.run_auto_lint.output.stdout.includes('error'), typecheck: nodes.run_auto_typecheck.status === 'SUCCESS' && !nodes.run_auto_typecheck.output.stdout.includes('error'), test: nodes.run_auto_test.status === 'SUCCESS' && !nodes.run_auto_test.output.stdout.includes('FAIL'), build: nodes.run_auto_build.status === 'SUCCESS', frozen_ok: !nodes.check_frozen_dirs.output.stdout.includes('FROZEN_MODIFIED') }; const checklist = (nodes.parse_checklist.output.checklist_items || nodes.create_default_checklist.output.checklist_items).map(item => { if (item.text.toLowerCase().includes('lint')) { return { ...item, status: results.lint ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', auto: true }; } if (item.text.toLowerCase().includes('类型') || item.text.toLowerCase().includes('type')) { return { ...item, status: results.typecheck ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', auto: true }; } if (item.text.toLowerCase().includes('测试') || item.text.toLowerCase().includes('test')) { return { ...item, status: results.test ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', auto: true }; } if (item.text.toLowerCase().includes('冻结')) { return { ...item, status: results.frozen_ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', auto: true }; } if (item.text.toLowerCase().includes('落盘') || item.text.toLowerCase().includes('交付')) { return { ...item, status: results.build ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', auto: true }; } return { ...item, status: 'MANUAL_REQUIRED', auto: false }; }); const passed = checklist.filter(i => i.status === 'PASS').length; const failed = checklist.filter(i => i.status === 'FAIL').length; const manual = checklist.filter(i => i.status === 'MANUAL_REQUIRED').length; return { checklist, passed, failed, manual, total: checklist.length, pass_rate: passed + '/' + checklist.length, auto_results: results }; })()

nodes.name: 生成通过报告
nodes.expression: ({ signoff_id: nodes.intake.output.signoff_id, task_id: inputs.task_id, result: nodes.aggregate_results.output.manual > 0 ? 'PARTIAL' : 'PASSED', signer: inputs.signer, checklist: nodes.aggregate_results.output.checklist, pass_rate: nodes.aggregate_results.output.pass_rate, blocking_issues: [], notes: nodes.aggregate_results.output.manual > 0 ? '部分项目需要人工验证' : '全部自动检查通过', completed_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: 生成失败报告
nodes.expression: ({ signoff_id: nodes.intake.output.signoff_id, task_id: inputs.task_id, result: 'FAILED', signer: inputs.signer, checklist: nodes.aggregate_results.output.checklist, pass_rate: nodes.aggregate_results.output.pass_rate, blocking_issues: nodes.aggregate_results.output.checklist.filter(i => i.status === 'FAIL').map(i => i.text), notes: '存在未通过的检查项', completed_at: new Date().toISOString() })
